decisions.reason: As an inexpensive, highly experimental extension of the firm’s physical-media niche, the white-label test vinyl series still has option value in 2025 because demand remains uncertain while the online catalog can carry it at relatively low incremental cost.

The German new wave compilation series fits the firm’s curated catalog strengths and collector audience closely, so in a growing retail environment its upside remains plausible and the firm is likely to keep it on the market rather than abandon it early.
